scope: Created before first final-test URformer evaluation; supplements frozen training/model configuration only.
primary: Final epoch50; mean per-example normalized squared channel error at each operating point, averaged linearly across three fits then converted to dB.
additional: Best validation checkpoint, ratio-of-error-sums and per-seed values; never choose a checkpoint by published/test curve proximity.
published_reading: Purple marker centers from PNG; .1dB rounded, approximately .2dB visual uncertainty, not raw source data.
comparison: Per-point differences to digitized curve; one-dB closeness is a display diagnostic, not author-defined reproducibility standard.
intervals: 2000 descriptive paired channel-bootstrap replicates conditional on three fitted models; not inference over training populations.
further_tuning: None allowed based on final-test results in this frozen attempt.
